data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): seed local_to_jira_status with a concrete non-empty mapping. Existing fixtures (tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_e2e_dedup_pass.py, test_applier_provenance.py) use status values 'open', 'in_progress', 'closed', 'Done', 'High'. Minimum required seed: {'open': 'To Do', 'in_progress': 'In Progress', 'closed': 'Done', 'deleted': 'Done'} — matching .claude/scripts/dso ticket transition's accepted local states. Without this concrete seed, task-3's preflight scan has no surface against which to detect an unmapped status, and the integration gate (task-6) passes vacuously.
